title: English speaking local Confinement helper (Pui Yuet)
label: childcare

posts.body:
Hello Everyone,

My partner and I decided to hire a part-time Pui Yuet to help after the arrival of our first child because we do not have a domestic helper or family can help. We need someone have experience take care of new born (helped with bath, nappy changes, burping, sterilizing, and comforting the baby ) and we are also interested in trying the traditional Chinese post-natal food too. We are looking for someone very flexible and understanding that as Westerner there are some traditions I am not going to follow (e.g, not washing hair and shower) 

I tried to contact Smart Baby Care Scheme. But seems they have difficulty find one for us. 

Does any one have recommendations ? Thanks a lot
